title: Remove stale --no-daemon flag references across repo
description: The --no-daemon flag was removed from bd in v0.51.0 (Feb 2026). Our installed bd is v1.0.2, which rejects the flag with 'unknown flag'. The flag is referenced in 15+ files including CLAUDE.md hard rules, skills, scripts, package.json alias, plans, and specs. Worktree safety in modern bd is automatic via git common-directory discovery (confirmed by 'bd worktree --help'). Action: strip --no-daemon everywhere, replace the rule wording in CLAUDE.md files, drop the broken bun alias, initialize beads with prefix 'ucs'.
close_reason: Stripped --no-daemon from all 15 files (rule, examples, scripts, alias, plans, specs). Updated rule wording in CLAUDE.md (project + global), README, and beads/using-this-repo skills to explain modern worktree-safety. Initialized beads with prefix 'ucs' in both DB and config.yaml (so fresh clones pick it up). Verified: bd ready, bd list, scripts/bd-recipes.sh ready all work.
